summary: Implemented SHACL path parsing. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path, SHACLPathError) and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. New tests and existing test/test_path.py pass (40 passed, shared generator venv). Nothing committed. Deviation: added an isinstance(..., Node) guard because None acts as a wildcard in graph lookups. Not verified: mypy, ruff, and black were not available in the venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading only.
